description: One row of findings.jsonl. Field meanings: docs/schema.md. Checked by the stdlib validator in forensic_analyze/findings.py.

allocated.description: True if the file's metadata entry is allocated; false if deleted or unallocated.

artifact_type.description: What kind of record produced the row; snake_case by convention, e.g. file_entry, usn_delete, recycle_bin_entry.

confidence.description: Confidence from 0 to 1, when the producing tool gives one.

datetime.description: Event time, ISO 8601 with a Z suffix, up to 9 fraction digits.

derivation.description: observed: read directly from a record; inferred: an interpretation by code; ai_generated: produced by a model.

evidence_id.description: Exhibit or target identifier from the run.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the target device or image, taken before the run.

finding_id.description: Stable ID assigned at merge, F-000001 onwards in module order.

hashset_name.description: Name of the hash set that matched.

hashset_version.description: Version or date of the hash set that matched.

label.description: Class label, signature, or rule name from a classifier or scanner.

match_algorithm.description: Algorithm that produced a hash or signature match, e.g. sha256, md5, ssdeep, yara, clamav.

md5.description: MD5 of the file content, lower-case hex.

message.description: One-line plain description of the finding.

model_id.description: Model name and quantisation, for rows a model produced.

owner_sid.description: Owner account SID, never a person.

parser.description: Parser or code path inside the tool, e.g. fls, mftecmd, dissect.ntfs.

path.description: Full path, display-safe (escaped). Raw bytes are in path_b64 when escaping changed anything.

path_b64.description: Standard base64 of the raw path bytes.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the fixed prompt file.

score.description: Numeric score from a classifier or matcher.

sensitive_flag.description: True if a classifier score passed the examiner's threshold.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file content, lower-case hex.

source_record.description: Where the raw record is: a path relative to the run folder, then # and a record locator.

source_tool.description: Tool that produced the record, e.g. sleuthkit, MFTECmd, dissect.

text.description: Longer text: an extract, transcript excerpt, or description.

threshold.description: Threshold the score was compared against.

timestamp_desc.description: What the datetime means, e.g. Creation Time, Deletion Time (Timesketch column).

tool_version.description: Version of source_tool as reported by the tool.

tz_basis.description: utc: recorded in UTC; local_with_offset: local time converted with a known offset; local_unknown_offset: local time, offset unknown.

title: AIRLOCK finding
